- Key constraints: VPC option likely required for production; will need answers on retention windows and SOC2 evidence traceability.

Proposed slots (PT):
1) Wed 9/16, 09:00–10:00 PT (45m focused runbook + Q&A)
2) Thu 9/17, 10:30–11:30 PT (60m, includes extra time for ops discussion)
3) Fri 9/18, 08:30–09:15 PT (short window if you want a narrower scope)

Agenda draft (suggested)
- 5m quick intro + objectives
- 20–30m architecture walkthrough (VPC, Private, Dedicated options)
- 15m performance and cost profiles for expected throughput (batching/caching recommendations)
- 10–15m open Q&A and next steps / decision criteria

Prep items (attached)
- MAP_SolariHealth_v1.pdf (one-pager for the session)
- prep_notes_cheatsheet.txt (short list of telemetry/data points helpful for the conversation)

Can you confirm which of the three slots works and the attendee list (Alysha and Marco noted above)? If you confirm, I will loop in Ben (SE) and Diego (solutions architect) to host/drive the deep-dive and they will send the calendar invite with a Zoom bridge.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
